title: Closeout summary: Phase 01A - Directive architecture and safety contract
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Closed Phase 01A from live child evidence. S01T01, S01T02, and S01T03 are closed with summaries bw_summary_62693cc4442e7577, bw_summary_2a7caf8953512628, and bw_summary_311076e357a6bafe. The architecture contract in docs/architecture/AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md defines trusted registry boundaries, dynamic data limits, precedence, conflict handling, command envelope obligations, directive families, lifecycle, source metadata, and acknowledgement rules. The prerequisite review/audit gate sprint bw_work_6a9af2fa7ed41af1 is closed and the Phase 01A plan records that gate-policy work as prerequisite truth instead of duplicating it. Validated with dep tree, prior sprint show, rg acceptance checks, bwrk docs check --json, bwrk schema validate --json, bwrk sync refresh --json, and bwrk doctor --strict --json.

Close reason: Phase 01A complete from closed architecture child tasks and prerequisite gate-truth validation
